title: Gravimetric analysis of sulfate
caption: Sulfate is precipitated completely as barium sulfate, filtered, washed, dried and weighed until two weighings agree (constant mass). The mass of BaSO₄ gives the moles of sulfate: 0.583 g ÷ 233.4 g mol⁻¹ = 2.50 × 10⁻³ mol.
alt: A flow: add excess BaCl₂(aq) → filter → wash → dry and weigh → repeat until constant mass.
description: Ba²⁺ + SO₄²⁻ → BaSO₄(s), with excess barium so all the sulfate precipitates.
Filter through ashless paper and wash with water.
Dry, cool and weigh; repeat to constant mass.
